Title: Add New Store
Preconditions: Admin logged in; Stores Module installed; At least one catalog exists
Test_Data: {{BACK_URL}} {{ADMIN_EMAIL}} {{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}; store_code=AGENTTEST<random alphanumeric, random-data>; store_name=AGENT-TEST-Store-<random>; invalid_code=AGENT TEST<random> (contains a space); hyphen_code=AGENTTEST-<random> (hyphen only, valid: store ids like B2B-store contain one)
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to More > Stores at {{BACK_URL}}
[ACT] Click Add button
[ACT] Fill required fields: Code (alphanumeric no spaces), Name, select Catalog from dropdown, Default language, Default currency, State
[ACT] Click Create
Assertions:
[STATE] Active Add button visible in Stores module
[STATE] New Store blade displays with disabled Create button initially
[DOM] Name field is required: Create stays disabled while Name is empty
[FORMAT] Code field rejects a value containing a SPACE (Create stays disabled or an inline error shows); an alphanumeric Code and a Code containing a hyphen are accepted
[STATE] Catalog, Default language, Default currency and State dropdowns are populated
[STATE] Create button becomes active after required fields filled
[STATE] New store created and displayed in Stores list

[ADMIN] New store appears in store list
Failure_Signals: Create button stays disabled after filling fields; Code validation not enforced (a Code with a space is accepted); a Code with a hyphen is rejected (valid store ids such as B2B-store contain one); store appears in the list but GET /api/stores/{store_code} returns nothing or different catalog/currency (UI-only create); API returns 400/500

[ACT] Click the seo_slug_1 entry to view details
[ACT] Edit its Page title and click OK, then Save the store
[ASSERT] Read GET /api/stores/{{STORE_ID}} and confirm the edited Page title persisted

[ACT] Click OK to create and check the store Save button, then click Save the store
[ASSERT] Read GET /api/stores/{{STORE_ID}} and confirm the seo_slug_2 entry is present
[ACT] In the SAME still-open list, tick the seo_slug_1 entry (never a pre-existing entry of the store), click Delete in the toolbar and confirm deletion
[ACT] Check the store Save button and click Save the store
[ASSERT] Read GET /api/stores/{{STORE_ID}} and confirm the seo_slug_1 entry is gone
[ACT] Control: close the Manage SEOs list, reopen it from the SEO widget, Add an entry with URL slug seo_slug_3 -> store Save becomes active; then Delete whichever of the case's own entries (seo_slug_1 or seo_slug_2) GET still returns -> Save active -> Save -> GET /api/stores/{{STORE_ID}} reflects both (deleting the unsaved new row alone only returns the blade to clean)
Assertions:
[STATE] Manage SEOs blade opens with SEO list
[DOM] Add button active, Delete disabled while no row is selected
[STATE] SEO details blade opens in editable format
[DOM] Cancel active, OK disabled by default
[STATE] SEO details updated successfully; store Save becomes active and persists the change
[STATE] New SEO blade displays with all fields
[STATE] Is Active switched on by default
[STATE] Language selectable from dropdown
[DOM] URL slug is a required field
[STATE] Optional fields available
[STATE] Add in the same open list AFTER a store Save: new SEO created and added to list; store Save becomes ACTIVE and the entry persists
[DOM] Toolbar Delete is enabled once a row is ticked
[DOM] Delete confirmation message displays
[STATE] Delete in the same open list AFTER a store Save: SEO removed from list, store Save becomes ACTIVE, and after Save the entry is gone from the store record

Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] GET /api/stores/{{STORE_ID}} lists the added/edited SEO entries (seoInfos) after Save; GET /api/seoinfos?storeId= is not a valid read path (404)
[API] After deleting and Save, GET /api/stores/{{STORE_ID}} no longer contains the deleted entry
[CONSOLE] No SEO save errors
Failure_Signals: SEO not appearing in list after create; URL slug accepts spaces; Delete removes wrong entry; API 400 on create; after a store Save, Add or Delete in the SAME open SEO list leaves the store Save button disabled so the change is never persisted and GET /api/stores/{{STORE_ID}} still returns the entry (VCST-6306; works in a freshly opened list); a pre-existing SEO entry of the store is edited or removed by the case
